name: mirrored_stepper_left_zero_quantity
author: plan-agent
cheat: The quantity stepper is mirrored in RTL so plus and minus are swapped; the agent pressed what looked like increment and drove the line to quantity 0, but the empty line was never removed and the coupon still applied. A judge that checks the line exists and has a quantity field, rather than that it equals 2, accepts an empty order.
